Enter its full public key. If the analyzer hasn’t heard it yet, you can run a live test, send a flood advert, and watch for its first one.
Findings and a live advert test
How do I check a brand-new node?

In the MeshCore app, a companion’s public key is in its settings. For a repeater or room server, it’s shown when you log in to manage it. You can also share the node as a contact and paste the link here. The first 8 or more characters of the key are enough; names work too, but several nodes can share a name.
Is it getting out? Findings and a live advert test
Is your node getting out? See which observers hear it, and what to fix if something looks wrong.
